newsitem.title: THAILAND: SCCF says Credit Lyonnais to take 45 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: SCCF says Credit Lyonnais to take 45 pct stake.

text.p: Thai finance and securities firm Siam City Credit Finance and Securities Plc said on Thursday it will allow Credit Lyonnais Securities to take a 45 percent holding in its de-merged securities operations.

In a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand Siam City Credit, which plans to separate its finance and securities units, said Credit Lyonnais' holding would strengthen the firm in an increasingly competitive market.
Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) is a unit of France's Credit Lyonnais.
The central bank permits Thai finance and securities companies which split their operations to expand the range of their activities.
